transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. Can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me?

Well, my family told me I needed to come. I... I just keep telling them that I’m the reason my friend died. I didn’t call her back when I should have, and I had some ugly thoughts sometimes. I know it's my fault. And now... I just know the Lord is punishing everybody down at our church because of me.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you been feeling down, sad, or empty most of the day, nearly every day?
I don't know if I'd use those words. I... I haven't really noticed feeling empty or sad, exactly. I'm just not sure.
Have you ever had a period, lasting several days or more, where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep than normal—even if it happened long before this current episode?
No, I haven't ever felt like that. I've always needed my sleep, and I've never had any time where I felt unusually energetic or elated. Just... normal, I guess, until recently.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy, even if you haven't felt sad?

Yes, I suppose I have. I used to do a lot of things. I loved going to choir, and my knitting circle... I'd play bingo, or take walks through Patterson Park. But now... I just sit in my chair. It just... none of it feels worth getting dressed for anymore.
Have you ever had a period like this before—weeks or months where you lost interest in things and felt this way—at any other time in your life, separate from what you're experiencing now?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had days where I felt a little tired or didn't want to go out, just like anyone else, but... never anything like this. This is the first time it's been this bad, where I just stop doing everything for weeks on end.

Did these beliefs about being responsible for your friend's death and causing the Lord to punish your church start around the same time you stopped enjoying things and lost energy, or did they begin separately from that?

They started around the same time. I mean, before my friend passed and I sank into this... this state, I never had thoughts like that. I never believed the choir or the pastor were sending warnings about me or that I was being punished. All of that... it only started happening after I got so low and overwhelmed with the guilt these past few weeks. It all just came on together.
